args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after the latest production deploy (v2.3.1), with an ~18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Automated SRE response: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production, in all regions. Rollback verified: service healthy with error rate back to ~0.2%. Follow-up: investigation into the v2.3.1 regression and fixes needed before redeployment.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after deploy v2.3.1 — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api's latest release, v2.3.1, was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Reverted checkout-api to **v2.3.0** — the most recent version previously healthy in production — in all regions.
3. **Verified**: Post-rollback status confirms the service is healthy in all regions, with error rate back to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Filed SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after deploy v2.3.1 — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the outage and the rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Follow-up for the team: investigate the regression in v2.3.1 before it is attempted again.
